blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuano standout Jared Bahay came through when it mattered most, outdueling fellow Cebuano Reinhard Jumamoy in the closing minutes to steer Ateneo de Manila University past National University, 69–65, in the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Men’s Basketball Tournament on Wednesday at the SMART Araneta Coliseum.
